notes.title: March '22 Update
notes.content:
With the new update, the game's engine has been updated to 4.27.

By this version, I have implemented Nvidia DLSS support to the game. If your graphics card supports DLSS, you can enable it via the General Settings menu. It should significantly improve the performance.

Cheers!

tags.feature: By this version, I have implemented Nvidia DLSS support to the game.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I just made a little change in the game. Now you can move forward just by holding the right mouse button, so the experience is even more relaxing than before.

Love and respect,
Tonguç
